description: Use when someone asks whether Google has indexed pages of their own product's site, or why a page does not show up. Index verdict, coverage, Google's chosen canonical against the page's own, last crawl, robots and fetch state, and rich results, from the product's connected Search Console, or from site (another property of the same site). Only URLs on that site; at most 20 per call and 20 per agent run, since each spends the site's own daily inspection quota. No cost to call.

site.description: Another Search Console property for the product's own site, as Search Console lists it (sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/), when the connected Google account can open it. Omit for the product's connected property.

url.description: A full URL on the product's own site.

urls.description: More pages to inspect in the same call.

name: inspect_url
title: Inspect URL
